svg.text: maps and output are a real test recording; shapes per recording (batch omitted); 145,417 parameters
one 2-D CNN branch per map (separate weights)
angle axis padded circularly (0° = 360°); pooling only along frequency, so 36 angles are kept
truth: front Healthy, rear PWM, right Healthy
speaker (sector) is faulty ← max over the 3 fault types ≥ 0.5
recording has fault X ← max over the 3 positions ≥ 0.5
position of fault X ← position with the highest probability
each of the 9 outputs is an independent sigmoid (rows need not sum to 1)
